result.summary: Found 1 issue: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' shows a loading spinner on top of an image that has already loaded. The rest of the layout (header, search, category chips, promo banner, 'Fastest near you' carousel, bottom navigation) renders correctly. Clipped carousel items and the partially visible card at the bottom are intentional and not reported.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a white circular loading spinner with a partial green arc in the center of its image. The ramen image behind it is fully rendered, so the spinner looks stuck. It covers the focal point of the photo and makes the page look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator once the image's load event fires (or when the data request resolves), and make sure the loading state is always cleared, including on cached image loads. Consider a skeleton placeholder instead of a spinner overlaid on content.
